title: EVALUATING THE ABILITY OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TO IDENTIFY ADHERENCE TO CONSORT REPORTING GUIDELINES IN RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIALS: A METHODOLOGICAL EVALUATION STUDY
